# Vendored libraries

These files are copied into this repository so the campus runs offline. Their licenses are the ones published on npm for the versions below, checked 2026-10-15. They are not covered by the course content license.

| File | Package | Version in this file | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| three.module.min.js | three | r170 (file header) | MIT |
| OrbitControls.js | three examples | shipped with the campus three build | MIT |
| anime.esm.min.js | animejs | 4.5.0 | MIT |
| rough.js | roughjs | 4.6.6 | MIT |
| d3.min.js | d3 | 7.9.0 | ISC |
| confetti.browser.js | canvas-confetti | 1.9.3 | ISC |
| markmap-view.js | markmap-view | 0.18.12 | MIT |

markmap-lib was not vendored. Its browser build imports markdown-it and other packages. The mind map on the Charts page is a tree this course wrote, drawn by markmap-view.
